test_title: PYST 29: SSC CHSL 2024 - English (Held On: 10 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
The given sentence is divided into three segments. Select the option that has the segment with a grammatical error. If there is no error, select ‘No error’.

The volunteer gave on to / the food packets to the / children of the orphanage.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the use of the preposition "**on**" in the phrase "**gave on to**."
 
• The correct preposition should be "**out**" instead of "**on**."
 
• The correct phrase should be "**gave out the food packets to the children**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 2** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The volunteer **gave out the** food packets to the children of the orphanage."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **children of the orphanage** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **the food packets to the** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **No error** – This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is an error in part 2.
